note: v1 catalog (spec §5): the 25 checker rules of §5.4, THEME-03 (checked by design-md validate), the 4 browser checks (browser.mjs measure, hito 3) and the 7 static SEO ids of §5.4 (only when DESIGN.md declares web.public: true).

rules.criterion: <html lang> present and a valid BCP 47 tag
<title> present and not empty

Static accessible name for button, a, input and [role=button]; icon-only buttons have a name. Roles that do not take their name from content (combobox, listbox, textbox, searchbox, slider, spinbutton...) need aria-label, aria-labelledby or an associated label
Exactly one main landmark
rules.source: WAI-ARIA 1.2 main landmark (good practice, not WCAG)

rules.criterion: input, select and textarea have a label (aria-hidden ones are skipped); a placeholder alone is a failure, stricter than axe and declared
img has an alt attribute; svg[role=img] has a name (presence only)
Viewport without user-scalable=no or maximum-scale below 2
No focusable element inside aria-hidden="true"; never on body
Text contrast between token pairs: 4.5:1, or 3:1 for large text; alpha composited; both themes
Non-text contrast (functional border, focus ring) of 3:1
outline: none/0 without a :focus or :focus-visible indicator (same rule or same base selector) that draws
Animation or transform transition without @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)
rules.source: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.3.3 (AAA); Media Queries Level 5 prefers-reduced-motion

rules.criterion: transition: all
rules.source: CSS Transitions Level 1 transition-property; pignolo-ui spec 2026-09-28 §5.4

rules.criterion: Color literals outside the token source, or a token of another family in a color property
rules.source: Material Design 3 color roles (consulted 2026-09-28); pignolo-ui spec 2026-09-28 §4.5

rules.criterion: Literal box-shadow outside tokens, or a token that is not an elevation token
Literal border-radius outside tokens, or a token that is not a radius token (for example var(--space-2))
DESIGN.md and CSS differ (through cssVars)
Primary, surface, radius or font are framework defaults and not declared
shadcn: at least 80% of color variables match a published baseColor
rules.source: shadcn/ui base colors (consulted 2026-09-29; version pinned in catalog/shadcn-base-colors.json)

rules.criterion: Declared dark theme is complete: every semantic color defined in both themes
Factory accent: primary with OKLCH hue 265-310 and chroma >= 0.12, or a blue to violet gradient
rules.source: Prompting Claude Opus 5.5, Frontend design defaults (consulted 2026-09-28); pignolo-ui spec 2026-09-28 §7.4

rules.criterion: Text with background-clip: text over a gradient (presence; contrast is reported as COLOR-03)
Emoji at the start of button, navigation link, h1-h6 or li text
Markers (data-sample or ‹…›) block when taken to real code; filler heuristics are medio
Marketing filler phrases (es/en); other lang is unverified
Template title, default favicon, generator attribution
Keyboard: Tab reaches every focusable element (navigation menu button included) and focusing it changes its computed styles; disabled controls are exempt (browser check B2)
Side margin of at least 16 px; edge-to-edge bars (for example the mobile nav) do not count (browser check B3)
No text with scrollWidth > clientWidth + 1 without text-overflow and no horizontal scroll at 320 px (browser check B3)
With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce and no scroll, all text of the first two viewports has opacity > 0 (browser check B4)

Touch targets: under 24 px (or the DESIGN.md minimum) is alto per element unless the 24 px circle centered on it crosses no other target (WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception); under 44 px at phone width (480 or less) is one medio entry per width and theme. Inline links in running text and disabled controls are exempt; the equivalent-control and essential exceptions are not measured (browser check)
rules.source: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 (AA); Apple HIG, tamaño de objetivo táctil (https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/)

rules.criterion: At phone width (480 or less) every visible, enabled text field (input, select, textarea) has a computed font size of at least 16 px, so iOS does not zoom the page on focus (browser check)
rules.source: pignolo-ui (decisión del autor 2026-10-01): iOS amplía la página cuando el campo tiene letra menor a 16 px

rules.criterion: Reading text: at most 80 characters per line in p, li and blockquote of more than 80 characters (line-length); leading of at least 1.3 in p and li of two or more lines (leading, 'normal' counts as 1.2); no visible text under 12 px (tiny-text). One entry per motive and page; DESIGN.md intentional wins (browser check)
rules.source: pignolo-ui (decisión del autor 2026-10-01); WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.8 (AAA, orientación) para el largo de renglón

rules.criterion: The first visible h1 is at least 1.25 times the body size (most frequent font size in p and li) in a brand register and 1.125 times in a product or undeclared register (browser check)

Every visible interactive element (by role, accessible name and href) of the widest measured width (1024 or more) is also visible at the narrowest (480 or less), or sits inside something a visible disclosure control opens (aria-expanded or aria-controls button, summary, closed details). One entry per page. What the control does when opened is not measured (browser check)
robots.txt exists or answers 404 (everything allowed), does not block the public routes or the render assets of the checked pages, and references a sitemap

No accidental noindex: meta robots/googlebot, Next.js metadata.robots or X-Robots-Tag; in the source of a public page alto (medio in a Next.js page or layout that is not the root layout or the home), seen only on the development URL detalle
rules.source: Google Search Central, robots meta tag and X-Robots-Tag, https://developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/robots-meta-tag (consulted 2026-09-29)

rules.criterion: Exactly one link rel=canonical, with an absolute URL
rules.source: RFC 6596 The Canonical Link Relation, https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6596 (consulted 2026-09-29)

rules.criterion: The sitemap referenced by robots.txt exists and is well-formed XML with the sitemaps.org shape
Title present, not empty and not repeated across the checked pages
rules.source: HTML Living Standard, the title element, https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/semantics.html#the-title-element (consulted 2026-09-29)

rules.criterion: No a without href used as a link; no href="javascript:..."
rules.source: Google Search Central, link best practices (crawlable links), https://developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/links-crawlable (consulted 2026-09-29)

rules.criterion: og:title, og:type, og:image and og:url present
